name: siteops-mvp
description: Framework - Frontend: React.js + Tailwind CSS - Backend: Python FastAPI - Database: PostgreSQL - Migrations: Alembic - Runtime: Docker Compose

scripts.local:start: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; process.exit(spawnSync(isWin ? 'powershell' : 'bash', isWin ? ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', 'tools/start-local.ps1'] : ['tools/start-local.sh'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status || 0);"
scripts.local:stop: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; process.exit(spawnSync(isWin ? 'powershell' : 'bash', isWin ? ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', 'tools/stop-local.ps1'] : ['tools/stop-local.sh'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status || 0);"
scripts.local:status: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; process.exit(spawnSync(isWin ? 'powershell' : 'bash', isWin ? ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', 'tools/status-local.ps1'] : ['tools/status-local.sh'], { stdio: 'inherit' }).status || 0);"
